description: Get the two ways to buy from GYOTAK, with the contact details for each: retail (order here through place_order, or browse the web shop) and B2B wholesale for restaurants and businesses (LINE @284ezjvm, tier pricing, application required). Call this when the user asks how to buy, how to open a wholesale account, or how to reach GYOTAK. Takes no arguments and returns static text — for product availability or prices use get_catalog, and for other questions use ask_gyotak.
name: get_contact_info
